settings.protocol: 5 independent sessions (a fresh Node process each), every one replaying workload seeds 2023 to 2032. Advisors run in a seeded random order per replicate, after one discarded warm-up replicate per dataset and engine.
settings.intervals: 95% pigeonhole percentile bootstrap over 5 sessions x 10 workload seeds (Owen 2007), B = 2000, seed 90050. sessionRange is the lowest and highest single-session point estimate. Sign tests, d_z and win counts use the 10 workloads, each averaged over sessions.
settings.reference: Hindsight reference: CoPhy branch and bound with a 5,000,000-node limit; referenceProvenOptimal counts the replicate runs where it proved optimality.
